steps.text: Everything you put in PocketBudJet stays on your phone. If the phone is lost or broken, a backup is how you get it all back. Tap the menu, then Backup & Restore.
Tap Create Full Backup. This puts everything you've entered into one backup file.

The backup file is saved on this phone. A copy on the same phone won't help if the phone is lost, so tap Share to PC / email and send it to your email, your cloud storage, or your computer. Here, tap Done.

To send your newest backup again later, tap Share latest backup to PC / email. Make a new backup after big changes. On a new phone, install PocketBudJet, come back here, tap Restore from Backup, and pick the backup file you saved.
